notes.title: Gundy v3.0
notes.content:
Hello Gundy players,

d4rkd0s here,
with a larger update for Gundy!

The following is what you should know, in order of most important up top:
- Level 2 was added
- Level 3 was added
- Unlockable area on the menu
- Mobs and levels were all tuned / balanced
- The resolution of the game is doubled

Enjoy the update, and per usual,
if you have any feedback, bugs,
or want to join the speedrunners,
Join our Discord here: https://discord.gg/y4nafdp29v

- d4rkd0s

notes.title: Engine Upgrade / Complete Rewrite
notes.content:
Hello Gundy Players,

This is a preliminary update,  which includes the following:

- Game Engine upgraded from 3.x to 4.x (major rewrite of the entire game in the engine)
- Boss fight has been balanced:
    - Boss fight room on Level 1 has been expanded
    - Boss animations have been polished
- Snakes have been balanced:
    - Snakes are a bit trickier now and provide an ample challenge

Speed run timer is still in place, and speedrun times will need to be reset on speedrun.com

Therefore the version of Gundy was bumped from 1.x to 2.x to support the new engine and slightly altered level 1.

Look out for another bigger update announcement soon, where I'm adding more levels & content!

I hope you enjoy <3
- d4rkd0s

notes.title: v1.0.4 Controller Support (+ Quick Reset)
notes.content:
Hello again,

This is a quick update, as I wanted some quality of life improvements in the game.

To start, I wanted to be able to play with controller. 

I've enabled both joystick and D-Pad controls, but I'd recommend the D-Pad!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36920110/a642143d8368c7d052d4bfeee162e0c77029c322.png[/img]

The speed running has been far too much fun, but the restarting of the game between runs, stinks. So I've added a [b]Quick Reset[/b] function. To [b]Quick Reset[/b], just press [b]Control[/b] [i]or[/i] R3 / [b]"Click right stick"[/b].

As always feel free to join the Discord, and provide ideas/feedback or post in our #speedrunning channel!

- d4rkd0s

P.S. Stay tuned in the Discord for a special release from Dr.Evil1200, an unreal reboot of Gundy!

notes.title: v1.0.2
notes.content:
- Added version number to main menu (to help users report issues with version of the game)
- Added the ability to reach the spawn area (in order to 100% the game, and kill the top snake)
- Added ability to restart the game on the pause screen
- Added ability to restart the game or "Play again" on the you win screen
- Made the generator easier to understand, it now only takes 2 hits and goes from Green to Yellow to Red
- Added a Speedrun timer! (My time is 1:40.9 probably easily beaten but hey its the first score!)
